original: The fairy says I already have all the power I need... As long as I use my own faith.
Honestly? That sounds like cheating.
I'll find my own way back!
Hey... you can pass, but him...
Ha ha! The Old Goddess will punish you!
For everything you've done to her sacred land!
Sven, this guy is insane... just let him through.
Oh, Goddess... I'm coming.
Goddess in the Swamp
Give faith
It took me some time to gather all of this.
Oh, don't be modest. I know you produce faith on an industrial scale.
A true priest of the Ancient God...
Very well. Are we ready?
Yes... lead me to the shrine!
You've brought him?
Once, the world was in balance.
But greed turned them against you.
In their greed they began to hate you.
You were betrayed... and left alone...
Yet I am here to worship you.
Hear me. How dare you!
I hear you... and I feel all your faith...
Wow... it actually worked!
I have so many questions... I need your power...
Excuse me... I have a rather delicate matter...
Yes. It's him.
What?
I just checked my notes... I think I still owe you some coins for your teeth.
Coins... right...
Follow me... let the Goddess speak with the Keeper.
Worshipers sure aren't what they used to be...
If you don't like me, I can leave!
No, stay, please.
Alright... I'm ready. Tell me when to start...
Start the ritual.
Alright... wish me luck. This is my first time...
Just speak from your heart...
I still need some answers
Tell me more about him.
Heh... of course.
Thank you.
Maybe if I knew something about him, it would help me find him.
He used to be a good boy... always playing those G&G games...
He lived in fantasy worlds... always inventing new ones.
Then we were in a car... and then suddenly, we appeared here...
The portal made us gods, and my brother finally got to create his own little Roman Empire.
That was many, many years ago...
These memories so tire me... Go. Find him.
Wait.
Hey folks, do you know where I'm going?
Off to pick mushrooms again?
I'm going to awaken the Goddess of Nature.
Good thing we elected Heffry instead of that guy.
Wait... didn't we elect Jeffry?
The Man with the Red Eye.
That's all there is. There's no magical yellow arrow, my friend.
One other detail... the place smells terrible.
Probably the sewers. I should talk to the Looter at the Port Club.
Maybe they can give me a hint.
Just think... perhaps my brother has already sent you some clues.
Do you have enough power to find your brother?
Mmm... I haven't felt this good in years!
Let me take a look...
Oh... he's very weak. Nearly powerless.
He's trapped somewhere underground...
Buildings, streets, zombies... all right above him. Rivers surround it on three sides.
It's like a cell, but not meant for humans...
Hm... I was hoping for something more specific...
I need some rest... and a snack.
Alright, let's just get this over with.
I brought some of your cheese.
That's not my cheese.
Weird... two wheels of cheese appeared under my bed.
Right after we talked about the ritual.
I figured it was a gift from you.
Fine... let's go!
Better Corpse
What exactly makes for a better corpse?
I can pray harder before sending them to you...Then they'll have more <sprite name="skull">.
But right now I don't really feel like it.
Unless...
Unless what?
Unless you could fix things up around here.
Nicer digs would definitely make my prayers more... effective.
Corpse Delivery
Okay... seems like I've finally met all your requirements.
You have.
So... my donkey can come and collect fresh corpses now?
Can he?
You may ask me every <sprite name="day_wrath"> how many corpses you'll need for the week.
If nothing changes, I'll keep sending the same amount.
That's what I needed to hear.
I fixed up the graveyard.
The graveyard is still small, but I think it looks good.
Of course it's small... and it's definitely not good yet.
It's... okay.
It takes knowledge to properly keep a graveyard, and bring forth its true greatness.
Yeah, I'm starting to realize how complicated it is.
Lucky for you, my order once possessed such knowledge.
Underground path
And me watching... powerless to help...
Okay, okay... of course we couldn't know...
I fixed your well. The sacred water is restored... although it smells a little suspicious.
Good... I rather like the idea of that filthy donkey enduring a sacred bath.
From now on, he washes his hooves before every visit. No exceptions.
Yeah... sounds a little sadistic.
What ever do you mean?
What do you or your donkey know of suffering?
What do you or your donkey know of pain...
Pain... Can you imagine the pain of my blessed sisters — burning alive?
Ask about the path
Can you remind me what I'm supposed to do underground?
Oh Lord... You were the one who wanted the debris cleared.
So I can use the water from the sacred well.
Forest Pass
Could you ask Jully about the Forest Pass?
Oh yes, here — Jully asked me to give you this.
Thanks.... Tell him... he has my vote.
Ask about papers.
He can be a little dramatic, sure... but I don't think he's that bad.
That's easy for you to say. You can come and go as you please.
I'm the one who has to stick around and deal with his... leadership.
He used to be alright... until the whole "authority" thing went to his head.
Just give me the paper. I'll take care of it.
WHAT?!
TEMPORARY?!
ELECTION?!
... He took that surprisingly well.
Yeah, I heard.
Hey, Januarius... there might be a problem with the Head of the Village papers.
Anyway, let's give him some time to cool off.
I'll let you know when Jully's ready to talk about the election.
Sure, take all the time you need.
I've got plenty on my plate besides politics.
Hmm... They look good to me.
You see the word "Temporary" on them?
Ah... yes. That's... inconvenient.
Jully won't be thrilled.
Exactly. The mailbox said we need an election to make it official.
Hmm... You know what? That might actually be really good!
An election could finally free us from Jully's little dictatorship.
Show the pass.
Who is Hans?
He's an old miner. Lives out in the forest.
He and his buddy Sven used to make the best moonshine.
Wait... Sven? I thought he was the leader of the bandits.
No no, the bandits killed Sven. Their leader is Robert now.
Veeeery interesting...
The miner?
Why's there a miner living in the forest?
Because there's an old abandoned mine there.
And a lumber mill.
Wow... is that a real Forest Pass?
Also abandoned?
Obviously.
Wait... have you already been to the forest?
Ohhh! I knew it... I knew he had a way!
Hans told us the mines are connected to the Inquisitor's dungeons.
Pssst! Shut up!
Hans and the Others
This Hans sounds like a fun guy. Where can I find him?
He's got a camp just down the road.
Right before the bridge to the other side of the river.
Yeah... the bridge to the cursed swamp!
The swamp?
I thought there used to be a lake over there.
Pfffft. There was a lake. Back in the Old God days.
Then someone carved a channel to the sea... drained it all.
Now it's just a stinky swamp.
Hey, come here... have a look at this! This guy's got a Forest Pass!
Oh man, I'm so jealous. All those juicy mushrooms just waiting to be picked...
So what stops you from going?
We don't have a pass.
Also, we're kind of, you know... scared of ghostly killers and bandits.
Have you ever actually seen any?
No... but Hans told us.
Forest Pass
Hi, are you Hans?
Who plans meetings in a swamp?
I need access to the old mine.
You look like a miner... is there any iron still left down there?
Absolutely not. No iron. Zero.
Hans, there's no such thing as a talking hedgehog... you little liar!
And who the sard is this?
Oh, he's a messenger from the king... we've been pardoned!
No, I'm not. As far as I know, there is no king anymore.
So that means... I can beat the soul outta you!
It's okay, I'm okay! Just give me a minute. Or an hour. Maybe two.
Who's asking?
About the Swamp
I need to cross the bridge to the swamp.
Everyone calls me the Graveyard Keeper.
Correct!
Second question: What is your favorite color?
Black.
Dark brown.
Dark gray.
Correct!
Alright, now let's get to the third question.
Third question:
Bring us a Royal Pardon from the Royal Mailbox!
You can't without our permission.
Wait... that's not even a question!
Robert gets the third question. But... he's not really in the mood to talk today.
Anyway... no pardon, no crossing.
Hmm... I believe I can.
Try it... and we'll cut the bridge while you're still on it. Right, Sven?
Right! No crossing without permission!
So... is there a way to get permission?
Yes! You just need to answer three of our questions!
... Seriously? Fine. Ask away.
First question: What's your name?
About the Mine
Is the mine even safe to use?
Yep. That's a pickle.
We have explosives... But we're not giving them to you!
Not unless you help us find our treasure!
Treasure?
Only Robert knows where it is. And he's... not exactly a chatty skull.
Well, I have a good idea who I could ask.
No way. We planted tons of explosives down there.
Hans. Tell him the truth.
Okay, okay... it's safe. We just forgot to take down the warning signs.
Yeah, but the main tunnel is blocked with rocks.
You'll need explosives to open it up.
Okay... and where am I supposed to get the stuff to make explosives?
Down the main tunnel. There's plenty of sulfur down there.
But I can't get down there without explosives.
I'm the Graveyard Keeper. I live up on the hill at the old Inquisitor base.
So what's a Graveyard Keeper doing in my forest?
So... you're Hans?
No, he's Hans.
Hans also wants to know what you're doing here.
First I need to get to the island in the swamp. I have a meeting there.
And second...
Why are you happy? You like your job that much?
Not that much, no... but now I think I'm safe.
You see, our deal was — you help me, and I give you the Necronomicon.
The thing is... I don't have it. But I do know a guy who might know where it is.
Hmm...
No, no "hmm"... remember, you're the one who messed up. All this water torture? That's on you.
So we're even...
I guess that's okay. So who is the guy?
Good, good... Larry warned me you'd be furious, but you're taking it very well... ha ha.
WHO IS THE GUY!?
I figured everything out with Sister Agatha...
Okay, okay... you know, you got a real temper buddy...
It's the Poet... now he's an Astrologer... calls himself Gunter.
I know the guy. Thanks...
Very awkward name choice. I once knew another guy named Gunter...
Anyway... back to work.
It's not a perfect solution... but the corpses will keep coming.
And?
... and you can keep bringing them.
But?
Yeah... from now on, you have to wash your hooves every time you go collect a corpse.
And absolutely no relieving yourself at the crossroads.
Ohhh... sard... that was close. Good!
The Ingenious Gentleman Don Keyote
Give the Royal Pardon
Yep, go right ahead.
By the way... do you like cheese?
Cheese?
Yeah, we found a wheel of cheese today. Sitting there on the bridge... just appeared out of nowhere.
Too bad our family has such a tragic history with dairy...
Why not. It looks tasty.
Show interest
So, now that you've got your pardon... any big plans?
Well... I'm gonna collect some mushrooms. For a stew.
Me... I'm still figuring it out.
Here's your Royal Pardon.
No, I mean like... in general. You gonna move back to the village or something?
No way! We like it out here. It's peaceful.
Good idea.
Oh! And let's open a shop. I've always wanted to haggle!
Wait, why isn't it on official royal paper?
Well, we don't really have a king anymore...
Just a temporary, unelected leader.
Hey, I know that guy... the weird dude in the wooden mask?
Yep. Very lovely.
He was trying to pick our mushrooms, so we chased him off.
So now I can cross the bridge?
Where do you think you're going?
What, you want us to chop down this bridge while you're standing on it?
Relax, relax... I'm only looking at it.
Hm... there's a sign.
Explosive traps inside. Do not enter. Hans
Great. What a warm welcome.
Looks like only Hans can defuse it.
No... If it collapses, I won't get any iron.
Can't See The Forest for the Iron
The Miners' Treasure
We should do it at night. It's more dramatic.
Thanks, Larry.
Just remember to bring a candle. I want to look my spooky best.
Larry. I need the help of a talking skull.
That's very specific. What's the job?
I need you to pretend you're a different skull...
The skull of a bandit leader...
And convince them to give me their explosives.
Hmm... do we even look alike?
You're kidding.
A skull is a skull... although he might have had a stronger chin.
Put a candle inside.
You're always so good at it.
Ahem... my friends!
Robert! See, I told you Sven! He can talk!
Oh Robert, we've missed you so much...
Yeah, Sven is such a bore.
Because I get tired of your endless foolery.
It's not foolery... it's called having an "imagination".
Friends, friends... I'm here to tell you...
You need to give all your explosives...
... to my good friend, the Graveyard Keeper!
Ok, lets do this! I'll be in your bag.
What?! No way! He still hasn't found our treasure!
Yeah, where is it, Robert? You're the one who hid it, right?
Me? The treasure? Uh... yes.
Yeah. You never even showed us.
Yeah. You just told us it was in a safe place.
But it was... a metaphor!
The real treasure... was our friendship!
That's what I've been keeping safe. And now... it's yours!
Be good to each other... my friends.
... That's kind of beautiful, actually.
What did I tell you about doing it at night?
Yeah... when Robert was still around, we really were better friends.
And now the Graveyard Keeper is also your friend.
Give him the explosives!
Okay. For Robert.
Larry's really killing it. Time to grab him.
What was that...?
Never mind.
Take me home... I feel so empty now. That performance took a lot out of me.
Are you ready, Larry?
Always!
Hey, he doesn't have a big chin! You liar!
Yeah, yeah...
Here they are — this is your moment.
Oh man, I really miss beating people up...
Town Supplied
Good thing I invented conveyor belts and automated workbenches before the zombies showed up.
Too bad we lost it all when they did.
Lost it? Ha! Nothing's lost. I'll get my workshop back. I'll rebuild everything.
Easier said than done...
Sure. But I'm smart enough to not be afraid of problems.
I'll handle the production plans at my workshop.
But the easy stuff? Well that's on you.
The easy stuff?
Yeah... You'll just need to clear out all those undead barbarians.
That's sarcasm. Right?
I brought that iron you asked for.
Ok then. Guess it's time for some easy stuff.
Ah, finally... You know, you're the one person I can trust!
And I'm the only hope this town's got...
Seems like I'm the last one left who remembers how to hammer a nail.
I know how to...
Yeah, yeah, sure you do...
But what we're talking about here is a little more complicated than nails.
All alone... keeping the fragile flame of civilization alive.
Workshop Hours
More keys
Exactly. An arena in the sewers — a Sewrena.
Clearing out the undead there would help my business a lot.
I'd be very grateful, and you could exchange that gratitude for something more valuable.
Now that sounds like a deal, Davy.
I see you have some new looting orders, Davy.
Yes, demand is growing along with the Town.
And you've been helping quite a bit, making the sewers safer for my crew.
I try my best. But to keep things fair, my sewer expeditions should be more rewarding.
Fair point. Hunting zombies through endless tunnels isn't exactly efficient.
There's an old collection reservoir down there. Zombies tend to wash down into it.
You could deal with them all in one place, before they spread through the sewer network.
You're telling me there's a fighting arena somewhere in the sewers?
So you got your workshop back. Are you happy?
But I still need to do what I need to do!
What's the problem?
To fix my workshop... I need my workshop!
Ah. I see.
Do you? Great. Then you can also see it's a disaster.
Starting from scratch is... not my thing.
Well, I do have an old Inquisitor workshop under my base. Maybe I could use that?
Perfect. Here's a list of what I need. You can use my blueprints... They're the only thing that survived.
Sure... if I ever get any spare time.
Happy? That's pretty much the opposite of what I'm feeling right now...
Well... I do have a workshop... but it’s not as advanced... I don’t know where I can make all this.
Be creative, my friend... I’ve heard rumors of an Inquisitor workshop buried somewhere under your base.
If even half the stories are true, you might find exactly what you need down there.
Here’s a list of what I need. Use my blueprints... they’re the only thing that survived.
Alright... I’ll take a look. My basement is big enough to hide a one more secret.
Hey, it should be easy for such a talented and handy engineer to fix everything up around here.
Inquisitor workshop
Can you tell me something about the workshop under my base?
Not much, to be honest... but the Inquisitors were way ahead of their time. No doubt about that.
There might still be something left down there... artifacts, devices... trouble.
Hm... now you’ve got my attention.
What worries me is the power source.
I have my water wheel... but the power they were using is a mystery to me.
I hope I’ll solve this one.
Talented, yes. Handy, yes. But they ruined everything!
And for what? None of this stuff even tastes that good!
You should have kicked those undead out of my workshop sooner!
I did my best! I have a workshop I'm setting up too.
There's a big shop under my base that still needs fixing.
Fine, that's fine. I'm sure you're doing your best...
Jack's Back in Business
See if you can focus on something peaceful.
Still... there might be something valuable across the river. Survivors, maybe.
Maybe there are, maybe there aren't. We'll talk about an attack when we have a clear and meaningful target.
You speak with such wisdom. It's just a shame to waste such a well-prepared army.
If you're itching for a fight, the sewers are always full of trouble. Davy would be delighted.
Alright... you convinced me.
Great. It's nice to see wisdom prevail. I'll be here if you need any help.
We secured the Town from the walls to the river. It's a good foothold.
I'm ready to push the zombies back even further.
Ah, the passion of youth... but why do we need to push now?
We've reclaimed a good piece of the Town, and we need to rebuild.
I know... I've been helping with the repairs myself.
Right now we don't need more space. We need more people.
Maybe you're right.
Of course I'm right. The river makes a fine natural defense.
Safe zone.
At last. We've been waiting for you...
You call him Larry now...
I couldn't trust anyone who's betrayed us twice.
Interesting... anyway, he stayed at home.
Good. Continue on your path...
I'll be waiting in the heart of the swamp.
I know things move at your own pace around here.
But keeping us waiting is still rude.
I did what I could... as always...
My lady grows weaker with each passing day.
I see...
You didn't bring that traitor, did you?
My lady wouldn't want to see him.
Who do you mean?
Heart of the Swamp
How many ruined churches do you have around here?
The one who serves your brother.
With respect, my lady... I serve no one.
Oh, of course... you're just next in the cycle...
In a role my brother has already tired of...
Who is your brother, by the way?
The Man with the Red eye...
A role none asked for — but many desired.
I'm terribly sorry...
But could we just skip to the "save the world" part?
Impatient. Just like my brother.
Don't spoil the moment complaining!
Naturally, he chose someone like himself...
Now it's your turn to save this world.
From what? We've mostly handled the zombie problem...
From extinction.... Lose the world, and you will lose yourself.
I've been too weak for ages... It was just my brother and the magic portal holding everything together.
Now he's weak too... something bad happened to him...
Your helper said my other half destroyed the world...
Yes... and no. My brother began the process...
But your other part... the previous Keeper... used the magic portal...
Somehow he nearly destroyed my brother and the portal itself.
Follow me... You'll be the first to see her in years!
You must find my brother.
And you must find and restore the portal.
I have... a few questions.
Man with the Red Eye.
Yes. Ancient God. Old God. Many names.
Where do I find him?
Somewhere in this world... trapped... nearly powerless.
I could try to find where he is... but I'm too weak...
If only one of my worshipers could perform a ritual here...
I know one. A man in a wooden mask... He's obsessed with nature.
He sounds just right. He should know the ritual. Bring him here.
... and I'll tell you where my brother is.
The magic portal...
What kind of magic are we talking about?
Someone in this world is always bound to the portal, even when it lies shattered in fragments.
The portal may have corrupted his soul, and driven him a little mad...
He would be obsessed with the symbols of the days...
He should know where it is...
Okay... I'll talk to my friend and try to figure out who that is.
When we arrived in this world, there was nothing.
Nothing but the portal.
It links worlds... and grants wishes.
Our wishes made us gods. Then we shaped everything.
So I just wish to save the world?
Wish whatever you want... but there's a trick to how it grants wishes...
You just need to restore it and activate it to bring its magic back.
Alright... how do I find the portal?
Shining crystals.
The fairy told me I could find blue crystals here.
Yes... they're my tears....
I shed them every <sprite name="day_envy">. Grieving over what has happened to this world.
They can suppress my brother's red-eye magic.
If that magic controls the undead...
Does that mean the undead are his doing?
Maybe... no... he wouldn't...
I don't know... I'm so tired...
Behold...
Just a moment...
Ah... what a pleasant dream that was...
Hello...
Oh. Is that who I think it is?
Yes, my lady. The man from another world...
The Violin
Is Linda... is she well? Is she healthy?
As far as I can tell, yes. She looks stunning.
Thoughtless of her... both to me and to Aleksta... On that fateful day they were together...
What day?
*cough-cough* Never mind.
It would be... good to hear Aleksta's violin again.
So can I take it?
Not so fast. That violin is very precious to me.
Before I give it away, I want to restore the varnish coating.
I guess that means you need some protective lacquer?
Albert, do you have a violin by any chance?
Exactly. But I don't have any left... and I must give priority to my experiments.
No problem. I can find some... or make it myself. Do you happen to know a recipe?
Of course I know. You're rather nonchalant for someone who only just started alchemy.
Here. Take the recipe.
No... Music is pathetic. I never played.
Maybe it's not yours. Could it have belonged to your sister?
My sister? — What do you know? Who told you that?
Answer me! *cough-cough*
Calm down. Linda from the port is looking for a musical instrument.
She says she was a friend of your sister, and wants to play the violin at her club.
... Linda. Yes, she is a friend of Aleksta.
Varnish Before You Fiddle
Give the Lacquer
So... can I take the violin now?
Alright... Tell Linda I'll come hear her play it.
Do you need a special invitation? A time and date?
*cough-cough* Don't bother.
I have a way of showing up... on time.
Here, I brought that lacquer you asked for.
Oh... *cough-cough* I already made some myself and covered the violin.
I couldn't trust a rookie with something so delicate.
Still... let's see what you made.
Unbelievable! I've been doing this for years... and you just started!
Look at that consistency... that shine...
So... it's good?
No.... But I'll still keep it. I can fix it. *cough-cough*
Violin
He sounded pretty sure...
Hmm, sounded sure... and how did he smell?
Smell? Uh... I didn't really notice.
My bad for asking a Graveyard Keeper about smells.
I remember him always reeking of chemicals and weird reagents...
Well look, you're the one who invited him... You deal with the smell.
Wait a second — the deal was just to bring you the violin!
Sure, sure. And now we have everything we need to attract more people.
But if you want this whole thing to actually work... then help me make this concert a success.
Okay, fine. How can I help?
Albert gave me the violin.
Buy some exotic incense from the trade ship, and bring it to me.
You're such a good boy!
By the way... who is Albert?
He's Aleksta's brother... Albert.
Right, right... then it looks like I'm all set.
Well, almost. There's one more thing...
Albert said he'd come to hear you play his sister's violin.
Are you sure he's actually going to show up?
Strings and Sinners
Exotic incense
They smell really good... I'll give them that.
Nice... what fine quality! We never had anything this classy in our town before.
Everything's ready now. I even had some time to practice.
Please stick around...  I want you to hear how amazing I sound!
Be sure to come by on <sprite name="day_lust">... I want you to hear how amazing I sound!
Starting the concert?
Pardon me...
What a moron.
Oh, you're here too?
Thanks for helping organize all this.
I like good music. And she knows how to handle a violin.
Yes, she's good... *cough-cough* ... although my sister is... was better.
What happened to your sister?
Of the two girls, of course it was my sister who would be stricken...
But... is she alive?
I like to think so... *cough-cough*
So... is everyone here?
You know what... this music, it gives me hope again.
I saw your little helpers learning some new tricks.
Work is what separates humans from the animals.
Huh... interesting theory. I think we need to talk about that more.
I'll be waiting for you in my lab.
But for now, let's listen.
Hurrah!
Bravo!
Linda... That was beautiful.
Oh, how sweet of you.
I don't see Albert... You told me he'd come.
Let's find a nice quiet place we can talk for a bit, alright?
I really don't have time.
Oh, not even a minute?
A couple of minutes later...
Alright... To the lab then.
See you there. We have zombies to discuss!
Ok.
Just start. He said he has his way of being on time.
If you say so.
There's our doctor now.
That's beautiful... *cough-cough*
Pssst...
Concept for a Concert
Personal Zombie Zone
Discuss zombies
Wow. I don't even know if that's possible.
It has to be. You are the one who has given me hope again...
I just need one good, smart zombie.
An interesting theory...
But I must to test it in practice.
Bring me a good zombie. One with 8 <sprite name="rskull">.
That's... not so easy to achieve.
Do it, and I'll share the whole of my alchemical knowledge with you.
Alright, I'll see what I can do.
Put the zombie on this examination table when you're ready.
Hi Albert, what do you want to talk about?
Yes, yes... I've got a little side project. *cough-cough*
I'm aware you know how to create the undead...
I'm working on it...
Don't be so modest. The sad fact is — you're quite gifted.
But my work is different. I'm seeking to reverse the process.
What — to make a corpse out of a zombie? That doesn't sound so hard.
No... to heal a zombie. To bring it back as a person.
This is where I need to put an 8 <sprite name="rskull"> zombie.
The bell.
It rings every <sprite name="day_sloth"> morning, and most of them seem to withdraw back to the town center.
Not all of them, but most.
Yeah... probably the ones who sang with you in your choir.
And the evening on the same day, a second bell rings and the zombies come back again.
Hmm... who do you think is ringing the bell?
We have no idea.
We use a little bell to make the zombies go away, but I still don't quite understand how it works.
Can you tell me more about these mysterious bells?
There's a bell somewhere in the town center.
Actually... there's two. A morning one and an evening one.
